name: Qube Browser 0.4.0 (v2)
notes:
Added:

* A new engine: Qube runs on Chromium's full browser now. Your sign-ins, site data and site permissions come along
* Apple Music in Qube: your library, search and playlists in the Library, a player with the other players in the sidebar, and Now Playing with lyrics in the side panel (Settings > Music to sign in)
* More than one window (Ctrl+N), and private windows (Ctrl+Shift+N)
* Picture in picture, by hand and when you leave a playing video's tab; Minimize puts the video back in its page
* Media tabs: Spotify, Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, HBO Max, Videoland and NPO play in a tab of their own, signed in
* Profiles, as in Arc: each Space picks one, and Spaces can share it
* Create a Space in the sidebar, with its profile and theme
* Drag a Space's button along the strip to reorder your Spaces
* Import from Arc and Zen, adding to what you have or replacing it
* A setup guide on first start
* Qube Spark (Settings): link previews with Shift, and Tidy, which groups your tabs; both use Claude Code if it is installed
* Air Traffic Control: links from other apps open in the Space you choose (Settings > Tab routing)
* Side panel: extensions' panels, DevTools, Apple Music, and Open in Side Panel on any tab
* Your own icon on tabs, Essentials, folders and Spaces: an icon, an emoji or a picture
* Arc's app menu under the logo, top left
* Tab groups: Save as Folder and Close Group
* Fold the pinned tabs by clicking the Space's name; Reveal Tab in Sidebar
* Search a site from the command bar: type its name and press Tab
* Pin extensions to a grid at the top of the sidebar
* History as a page (Ctrl+H), archived tabs in the Library
* Media player in the sidebar, with Arc's volume slider and titles that scroll when they don't fit
* Music notes over a tab that plays sound; click its icon to mute it
* Save as PDF (Ctrl+Shift+S) and Print (Ctrl+P)
* Site notifications
* Sites can open your email links, and links that open an app ask first
* Bluetooth, USB, serial and HID devices for sites that ask
* Choose the key that opens a Peek with a click: Alt, Shift or Ctrl
* Choose the download folder, and one theme for the whole app
* Chromium's settings pages as Qube's own
* Drag and drop with pages: drop files, text and links on a page, and drag from a page to another app
* The first start after Windows starts, Qube comes out of its box (Settings > About > Opening animation plays it)

Improved:

* Sign-in windows (Google, Apple) open as a tab next to the page
* The page's right-click menu is Chrome's own, with View Source and Inspect
* Protected video and H.264, AAC and HEVC playback
* Pages follow Qube's light or dark
* Pinned tabs and today's tabs scroll on their own, with the line between them always in place; drop a tab on the line to pin it
* Rows, Essentials and buttons fade in and out as you point at them
* Essentials take their favicon's colour more clearly, or your own icon's
* The sidebar grows as you add Spaces, so every Space fits in the strip
* Link previews grow in and out, stay over the page, and skip sign-out links with a note
* Favicons are sharp: the right size is picked and drawn once
* Resizing the window keeps up with your screen
* Starts faster, without a black window, and without a wait after an update
* No more short stalls while you use Qube
* Clear keeps the tab you are on and sweeps the others away
* Space colours and sidebar text drawn exactly as Zen draws them
* Folders open and close with Zen's animation
* The Library is smoother, and Downloads lists your download folder
* Downloads fly to the Library button, with Retry and Copy Link
* Settings as Windows 11 cards
* Busy background tabs are frozen in energy saver, and unloaded when memory runs low
* Qube comes back on the tab, pinned tab or Essential you left, with the window where it was
* Ctrl+S shows and hides the sidebar, as in Arc (it was Ctrl+B)
* Ctrl+Shift+R and Ctrl+F5 reload past the cache
* The window fades in once its page is drawn
* The tab you are on shows under its folder when the folder is closed, as in Arc
* Only the media player you point at shows its title, and the players move up out of the downloads stack's way
* The wheel scrolls the field or frame under the pointer

Fixed:

* Links from other apps did not reach a Qube that was already open
* Site notifications did not show
* A mistyped address showed an empty page
* Downloads from other Spaces were missing, and a download could replace a file with the same name
* A page could start many downloads by itself
* Clear Cookies cleared the first Space, not the one you are in
* Deleting a Space signed you out, and a deleted profile's data stayed on disk
* Importing from Zen put every Essential in every Space, and Arc themes came out pale
* Private Spaces kept site icons on disk

Removed:

* The download card (the Library button's stack replaces it)
* History in the Library (it is a page now)

Known:

* Extensions don't move to the new engine: Qube lists yours and links to the Web Store, and what they had saved comes back when you add them
* Windows' Smart App Control blocks Qube, because Qube is not signed. Turn it off in Windows Security > App & browser control
* The update is about 290 MB, and Qube is gone for a minute or two while it installs
* A second window has no side panel, and fullscreen and automatic picture in picture work in the first window only
* Not every media tab service is tested yet
* Touchpad swipe is untested
summary: Qube v2: Qube runs on Chromium's full browser now, with more windows, private windows, picture in picture, media tabs and drag and drop.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.3.2
mac.notes:
Added:

* Create a Space in the sidebar: name, icon, profile and theme, before it is made
* Collapse your pinned tabs: click the Space's name
* Hold the mouse button on the Space buttons and sweep across them to go through your Spaces
* The Library has icons of its own that move when you choose a section, in your Space's colour
* The Library button is a toy box: point at it and its stars come up

Changed:

* The sidebar follows Zen's sizes, spacing, corners and colours, without glass on glass
* Switching Spaces slides the old one out as the new one comes in, over half a second
* Clear and Tidy stay under your pinned tabs instead of scrolling away
* The URL bar stays put when you switch Spaces
* A new Space's empty Essentials area is no taller than a row of Essentials

Fixed:

* Importing from Zen put every Essential in every Space
* Importing from Arc gave some Spaces the wrong colours
* The Library's section buttons stretched to the window's height
* On a click, the new Space showed over the old one for a moment before it slid in

Known:

* To fix an earlier import, import again and choose Replace
mac.summary: A sidebar that looks and moves more like Zen's, and a Library of Qube's own.
